title: Report: SpaceX Rents AI Computing Power to Anthropic and Google
summary: The New York Times reported on Nov. 23 that SpaceX has since May been renting large-scale computing power from its data centers to Anthropic, Google and others for billions of dollars a month, citing three unnamed sources; Musk reportedly told employees SpaceX lags in AI and that selling compute is more profitable than using it internally.
